description: You received a grade of 78% (C+) in Chemistry 201, but believe it's incorrect. Using the raw grade data in /home/ga/Documents/chemistry_grades_raw.txt and the syllabus grading breakdown, create a verification spreadsheet that calculates your actual final grade using weighted averages. The syllabus states: Labs 30% (lowest dropped), Homework 15%, Midterm 25%, Final Exam 30%. Create formulas to calculate category averages and the weighted final grade, then identify the discrepancy with the posted grade. Save as /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/grade_verification.xlsx.
